description: This file defines a React-like component named 'Home' using LightningJS's Blits framework. It imports components, sets up component structure with template HTML, manages internal state and lifecycle hooks for UI animations, and handles transitions such as rotations, scaling, and fading effects. The page includes a logo, loader, greeting text, and a button with specific styling and transition effects.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the Home page with animated elements, logo, loader, and button.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Rotates the background color of the loader element at specified intervals, cycling through predefined colors.
